test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Seven people, P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting in a straight row facing the north. Only two people sit to the right of U. Only two people sit to the left of R. Only two people sit between U and Q. Only three people sit between R and V. T is not an immediate neighbour of U. S sits to the right of U. How many people sit between Q and V?
solution:
Explanation:

From the given information:

Step 1: Only two people sit to the right of U. Only two people sit to the left of R. Only two people sit between U and Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9afc91bf566dabe37a7a2fb7ff818dc61ded2fa6c1bcbda400590041ce03b226.png] We place U third from right and R third from left and then we place Q leaving two spots in between Q and U.

Step 2: Only three people sit between R and V. T is not an immediate neighbour of U. S sits to the right of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c3b41d18c9452869a0125a2b2170a4a3efc94f997dc6300149504b59ee79ba7.png] Now we place V such that there are three spots between R and V, now we place T at the end and then place S right next to U. 

Now we place P at the only spot left.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1246f90fb7f294acbdeb5906ab884f760cf24ad2d9ec1ad7a1a2dd27454b1bc6.png] 

From the arrangement, we can see that **4 people sits between Q and V.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 3.**
